sn_aia_tool.description: Submits a Manager Support Request (MSR) for one of the manager's direct reports through the Request Manager Support record producer. Use ONLY after the manager has said Yes to the latest list of values. Returns the request number.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"team_member","description":"Full name of the direct report the request is for","mandatory":true},{"name":"request_type","description":"Request type label, e.g. Onboarding support, Offboarding support, Role change / transfer, Learning & growth plan, Performance support, Leave / return-to-work, Other","mandatory":true},{"name":"due_date","description":"Due date as yyyy-MM-dd","mandatory":true},{"name":"summary","description":"Short summary of the request","mandatory":true}]
sn_aia_tool.name: Submit manager support request
